items.evidence: For the NEOs, 40% of the objective performance goals, which accounts for 70% of the overall Annual Incentive Bonus Plan payout, is based on a consolidated adjusted net revenue goal.
For the NEOs, 60% of the objective performance goals, which accounts for 70% of the overall Annual Incentive Bonus Plan payout, is based on a consolidated adjusted operating income goal.
The IPF is weighted at 30% of the total payout under the Annual Incentive Bonus Plan.
For each of the NEOs, including the ceo, the Committee does not assign a specific weighting to any of the individual goals, and instead performs a holistic review
PRSUs are earned based on three-year EPS performance against pre-established annual targets, subject to downward or upward adjustment of 25% based on relative TSR
three-year relative TSR performance is measured against the S&P 500 and has the potential to modify the award.

equal_split.evidence: Adjusted net revenue (weighted at 40%) and adjusted operating income (weighted at 60%) targets.
